# Audio Module Audit

This document records the state of the files under `src/audio` and `include/audio` and highlights any cleanup opportunities.

## Dead or Generated Files

- `src/audio/cmake_install.cmake` – generated by CMake install; safe to delete.
- `src/audio/CMakeLists.txt` – required for building the `sep_audio` target.
- `src/audio/README.md` – documentation (keep).
- Root and other subdirectories contain additional `cmake_install.cmake` files which appear to be leftover from a previous install step.

No leftover binaries or test artifacts were found in these directories.

## Header to Source Mapping

| Header | Source | Notes |
| ------ | ------ | ----- |
| `include/audio/config.h` | `src/audio/config.cpp` | Defines `AudioPipelineConfig` and `AudioCoherenceEngine` |
| `include/audio/pipeline.h` | `src/audio/pipeline.cpp` | CPU side processing of audio frames |
| `include/audio/pipewire_capture.h` | `src/audio/pipewire_capture.cpp` | PipeWire based capture backend |
| `include/audio/capture.h` | *(no .cpp)* | Pure interface; factory implemented in `pipewire_capture.cpp` |
| `include/audio/types.h` | *(header only)* | Common structures and enums |
| `include/audio/pipewire_includes.h` | *(header only)* | Conditional stubs and inline wrappers |

The stubs inside `pipewire_includes.h` are implemented inline to allow compilation without the PipeWire library. No other inline candidates were identified in the sources.

## Cleanup Suggestions

- Remove `cmake_install.cmake` from `src/audio` and from other module directories since they are generated by CMake.
- Verify that build scripts do not regenerate these files under version control.
